newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Perez Companc sells shares of Central Costanera.
newsitem.headline: Perez Companc sells shares of Central Costanera.

text.p: Argentine conglomerate Perez Companc said Monday it agreed to sell its shares of local utility Central Costanera to Kansas City Power & Light Co for $23.44 million.
Perez Companc told the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange in a statement that the deal will give it a gain of about $10.8 million.
Perez Companc added the deal, subject to approval by authorities, would be done through its unit Maipu Inversora SA.
Central Costanera is Argentina's largest thermoelectric generator. It is controlled by a consortium headed by Chile's ENDESA.
